in_hebrew.name: Kean
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kean הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'keanos', meaning 'of Crete' or 'vigorous, strong'. In Greek mythology, Kean was a son of Apollo and a Lycian princess, or a legendary Cretan king. In Christianity, Saint Kean of Crete is a revered martyr.
